notes.title: Enchantment 2 released!
notes.notes:
Embark on a mystical journey in the Melleryn Kingdom and unravel the fragmented tale in this enchanting hidden object game. Delve into various game modes including fragmented, matching pairs, and all of a kind, with additional puzzles such as rotate, shard, and hangman. Enjoy captivating graphics, enchanting music, and a magical story chronicled in a spellbound book. Track your achievements and collected fragments. Play now for endless fun and entertainment!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3049400/Enchantment_2__Suns_tear/?beta=0
